channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Juli Hobson
item.description: Juli Hobson, age 61, of Taylors Falls, Minnesota, passed away peacefully, yet unexpectedly, on Wednesday, February 4, 2026.

item.title: Jerald Palmer Holland
item.description: Jerald Palmer Holland, 93, of Austin, Minnesota, passed away, Sunday, February 8, 2026 at St. Mark’s Lutheran Home in Austin.

item.title: Wangen honored as Minnesota Federation of County Fairs District 1 Fair Person of the Year
item.description: Renee Wangen, a dedicated Mower County Fair volunteer who helped secure a new permanent stage and thousands in sponsorships, is named District 1 Fair Person of the Year.

item.title: Terrific tradition: APDT prepares for 25th straight state meet
item.description: Austin Packer Dance Team clinches 25th straight state berth with first in high kick and second in jazz at the Section 1AA meet, extending a quarter-century legacy.

item.title: Union representing secretaries at APS notifies district of strike notice; talks ongoing
item.description: Superintendent Dr. Joey Page made the announcement during Monday night's board meeting, saying it doesn't automatically mean a strike.

item.title: Packers win final home game of the season over Winhawks
item.description: Austin boys hockey blanks Winona 5-0 in seniors' final home game, with five different Packers scoring and goalie Tait Johnson posting a 16-save shutout.

item.title: KoMets outlast Packer girls in double OT
item.description: Kasson-Mantorville edged Austin 73-70 in double overtime Monday, despite 17 points from Gracie Arndt as the Packers’ effort came up just short on the road.

item.title: Rebel girls lock down Knights
item.description: Southland girls roll past Knights 50-16 in Kingsland, led by Juliette Matheis' 12 points, 10 rebounds and two blocks as the Rebels improve to 19-3.

item.title: Rebels surpass 100 in win over Kingsland
item.description: Tate Goergen scores 29 as Southland boys roll past Kingsland 103-34 in Adams, improving to 20-1 overall.

item.title: Lyle-Pacelli boys fall to Spring Grove
item.description: Lyle-Pacelli boys fall 76-70 at Spring Grove despite 21 points from Hunter Wollenberg; LP drops to 7-15, Spring Grove improves to 8-15.
